jobs.occupation: Site Finance Business Partner - Arla Production Sites - Central Jutland
jobs.description:
Drive performance at two of Arla's key production sites

Are you passionate about turning insights into action and creating business impact? Do you enjoy partnering with leaders, influencing decisions, and helping teams deliver results?

We are looking for a Site Finance Business Partner to join our Production Finance team and support two productions sites in the Central Jutland region. Whether you already have Business Partner experience or ready to take the next step, we would love to hear from you.

How you will make an impact

As Site Finance Business Partner, you will work closely with the site leadership team, influence strategic decisions, and help drive performance across two production sites.

You will turn financial insights into actions, challenge assumptions, and support decisions that create long-term business value.

Your responsibilities include

• Partnering with the site leadership team on strategic and operational decisions

• Driving forecasting, performance management, and financial transparency

• Translating financial data into clear business recommendations

• Identifying opportunities to improve profitability, productivity, and efficiency

• Ensuring consistency and quality in forecasts and performance reporting

• Collaborating closely with Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance colleagues

• Supporting improvement initiatives and implementation of best practices

As the financial lead for the sites, you will be the key link between Finance and Operations, helping create one shared view of performance and priorities.

Being close to your stakeholders is key to succeeding in this role, and your work location will therefore be split between the two production sites.

What will make you successful

We are looking for a curious, ambitious finance professional who enjoys working equally with people as much as numbers.

You likely have

• A degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field

• Experience within Business Partnering, FP&A, Consulting, or a similar finance role

• Strong analytical, stakeholder and communication skills

• Experience with forecasting, business cases, and performance management

• A proactive mindset and confidence engaging with senior stakeholders

• Knowledge of SAP and Business Warehouse solutions is an advantage

• Fluency in Danish and English

Most importantly, you are eager to learn, develop, and make a real difference.

What we offer

At Arla, your development matters. You will join a collaborative and supportive team in a visible role with significant business impact and exposure to senior leaders and strategic decision-making. You will have strong opportunities for learning, career growth, and internal mobility in a culture built on trust, teamwork, and inclusion, while contributing to a more sustainable future for dairy production.

Would you like to join us?

Please apply as soon as possible. We will review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and close the position as soon as the right candidate is found.

For questions, please contact Morten Fabricius Fransen, Associate Director, Production Finance, DK  Export SPC & Powder, at +45 91 31 14 78 or mofrn@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Do you thrive in the sweet spot between international B2B sales, strategic business development and complex negotiations - in a role with real commercial impact? Join Danpo to drive Scandi Standard’s international QSR business by winning new customers, developing strategic partnerships and turning market opportunities into profitable growth.

Drive international growth through new QSR partnerships

Danpo is part of Scandi Standard, one of Europe’s leading poultry producers, with more than 4,000 employees and well-known brands across Northern Europe. Serving more than one billion meals annually, the Group focuses on growth through innovation, operational excellence and strong customer partnerships, with Ready-to-Eat (RTE) products and international QSR customers as key priorities.

To support this ambition, Danpo is looking for an International Key Account Manager QSR to expand the Group’s international customer base and turn market opportunities into profitable business. You will join the European Markets & QSR team, working across Sales, Category, Development and Business Development to develop customer solutions that profitable growth. Guided by Scandi Standard’s vision, “Better chicken for a better life”, you will help build partnerships that create value for both customers and the business.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Actively prospect and win new international QSR customers, taking opportunities from first contact to signed agreement and launch.

• Map the QSR market, identify priority targets and build a focused prospect list across relevant countries and customer segments.

• Create access to key decision-makers through proactive outreach, networking, referrals and persistent follow-up.

• Develop and execute clear go-to-market and customer acquisition plans for the international QSR channel.

• Build and actively manage a strong, qualified opportunity pipeline with clear next steps, conversion milestones and commercial priorities.

• Lead new-business pitches, customer tenders, contract negotiations and the commercial onboarding of new accounts.

• Drive profitable growth from both new wins and selected existing accounts, with clear ownership of customer P&L and budget performance.

• Work closely with NPD, Quality, Supply Chain, Production, Finance and Customer Service to create competitive customer solutions.

• Translate customer and market needs into product, assortment and innovation opportunities.

• Monitor customer developments, market movements and competitor activity, and convert insight into action.

• Use relevant sales tools, KPIs and performance management disciplines to create transparency and momentum.

The position can be based at a Scandi Standard office in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Ireland, the Netherlands or Lithuania. You will report to Rasmus Vinther, Sales & Category Director RTE & QSR. The role involves international travel of approximately 40–50%, depending on business needs.

Are you commercially driven, curious about market needs and passionate about turning insights into successful products? We are looking for a Product Manager to take commercial ownership of our workwear assortment within the industry segment and help shape products that create real value for professional users.

Your role

As Product Manager, you will be the link between the market and our product development organization. You will translate customer needs, market insights and business strategy into competitive, relevant and profitable products for professionals working across industrial environments.

You will take responsibility for development projects from initial decision through to launch, working closely with Design, Product Development, Purchasing & Quality, Production, Marketing and Sales. Once products are launched, you will follow their commercial performance and use market feedback and data to continuously optimize the assortment.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Analysing market trends, customer needs, competitors and new developments within workwear and PPE for industrial environments

• Identifying product opportunities and assessing their market and commercial potential

• Defining product positioning, requirements, target pricing and expected profitability

• Preparing clear product briefs and driving development projects from concept to launch

• Working closely with Design and technical teams to ensure the right balance between functionality, durability, comfort, quality and market needs

• Coordinating cross-functional stakeholders throughout the development process to ensure progress and timely launches

• Building business cases and supporting commercial decisions for new products and collections

• Monitoring sales, profitability, assortment performance and market feedback and turning insights into concrete actions

• Driving continuous product improvements based on end-user feedback, quality data and sustainability considerations

• Developing and optimizing the industry assortment through product improvements, additions and phase-outs

• Providing clear product USPs and commercial input to Marketing and Sales

Who are you?

You combine a strong commercial mindset with an analytical and structured approach. You understand the needs of professional users and know how to translate market insights into relevant product opportunities. You are comfortable taking ownership and driving projects forward in collaboration with multiple stakeholders.

We expect that you:

• Have solid experience in product management and product development within technical textiles or apparel – ideally workwear

• Have experience with market and competitor analysis, benchmarking and product requirements

• Have successfully managed product development projects from concept to launch

• Have a good understanding of textile materials, functionality and technical product solutions

• Are commercially minded and comfortable working with pricing, margins and product performance

• Are structured, results-oriented and able to manage several projects simultaneously

• Communicate and collaborate effectively across functions and cultures

• Are fluent in English

You will join a highly cross-functional environment where market understanding, product expertise and commercial thinking come together to develop a competitive and relevant workwear assortment for professionals across the industrial sector.

What you can expect at our headquarters

Working at MASCOT is about more than the job itself. At our headquarters in Pårup, we want to create an environment where you can enjoy your working day, connect with colleagues and be part of an international organisation.

As part of the team, you can benefit from:

• On-site staff restaurant: daily freshly prepared meals available through our subsidised lunch scheme

• On-site gym: giving you the opportunity to stay active before or after work.

• Pension plan: providing additional security and helping you plan for the future

• Health insurance: giving you access to additional healthcare support when you need it

• An international working environment: collaborate with colleagues across different countries, functions and cultures

• Employee discounts: enjoy special discounts on MASCOT workwear and safety footwear

And most importantly, you will become part of a Danish family-owned company where collaboration, responsibility and long-term thinking are at the heart of how we work.

Ready to join us? We look forward to hearing from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We reserve the right to close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

At MASCOT, we value diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace. All applications are considered based on skills and qualifications, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other personal characteristic.

Role and impact:

As Principal Cost Estimator, you will play a pivotal role in preparing competitive cost estimates for Topsoe’s proprietary hardware and total installed costs for proposals and studies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including licensing, business development, proposal management, project teams, product management, and process and mechanical engineering—to provide expert cost-estimation advice that supports strategic management decisions.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Preparing cost estimates for proprietary hardware and total installed costs for proposals and studies

• 
Contributing to early-study and Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) cost estimates

• 
Understanding the scope, contract, schedule, project execution approach, local conditions, construction execution, and financing assumptions relevant to each proposal

• 
Planning estimate methodologies that meet customer expectations

• 
Reviewing and benchmarking estimates using experience data and checking estimate quality

• 
Developing cost-estimation tools, methods, processes, and products

• 
Supporting standardization and effective execution of Topsoe technology solutions

• 
Presenting cost information to management to support decision-making

• 
Coordinating cost reviews with internal departments and, where relevant, customers and other teams

Your work will have a direct impact on the competitiveness and quality of Topsoe’s proposals and project delivery. You will also drive improvements in standardization and execution of Topsoe technology solutions, ensuring all estimates are well-founded, benchmarked, and aligned with project scope, schedule, and customer expectations.

What you will bring:

You bring a broad understanding of cost estimating, cost engineering, or related fields, ideally with experience in mechanical, process, or chemical engineering. Familiarity with Topsoe’s proprietary hardware design and technology solutions is highly valued. You are comfortable working with incomplete data and can apply structured, efficient methodologies to deliver high-quality estimates under pressure.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 
Ideally, around 10 years of relevant mechanical/process/cost estimating/cost engineering, or similar

• 
Strong collaboration and networking skills, enabling you to build effective relationships across disciplines

• 
Motivation for knowledge-sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement

• 
The ability to work in a structured, efficient way, manage multiple tasks, and maintain focus under pressure

• 
Proficiency in spoken and written English (Danish is advantageous but not required)

• 
Flexibility and openness to improving ways of working and contributing to the ongoing development of estimation tools, methods, and processes

• 
Experience in an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) environment are considered relevant, but not mandatory.

Why join us:

Joining Topsoe means becoming part of a global leader in advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition. You will have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that drive sustainability and energy resiliency worldwide.

We offer:

- A collaborative and inclusive culture where your expertise is valued

- Professional growth supported through learning, mentorship, and career development opportunities

- Empowerment to innovate and contribute to meaningful change

- A healthy work–life balance in a supportive environment

At Topsoe, you will be part of a team that is committed to making a difference and supporting your professional journey.

Your new team:

You will join a team of skilled and professional colleagues who are passionate about delivering high-quality solutions. Our team values open collaboration, shared success, and continuous learning, creating an environment where everyone’s contributions are recognized and respected.

You will work alongside experts from diverse backgrounds, fostering innovation and excellence in everything we do.

How you can apply:

If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.

Application deadline: 03-11-2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying to ensure a fair and unbiased process.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

About us:

Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

Help Create Structure and Alignment Across Our Supply Chain

Are you passionate about SIOP, data-driven decision-making, and building alignment across the supply chain?

Do you want to play a key role in building and driving our Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) process while strengthening the connection between Sales, Production, Procurement, and Logistics?

At Etac, R82, we are looking for a SIOP Process Owner who can help take our planning and decision-making processes to the next level as part of our ambitious growth and transformation journey.

About the role

This is a newly established role that will play a significant part in how we plan, manage, and develop our supply chain going forward.

You will be responsible for establishing and driving our SIOP process, ensuring alignment between demand, inventory, capacity, and supply. At the same time, you will play a key role in transforming data into insights that support better and more proactive decision-making across the organization.

You will work closely with both the organization in Gedved and sales companies across our global Paediatrics business.

Initially, this is a specialist role reporting directly to the Head of Operations. Over time, we expect the function to evolve further and potentially include people management responsibilities.

You will join us at an exciting time as we continue to develop our Operations organization and implement our new ERP platform, M3.

Your key responsibilities

· Establish and continuously develop our SIOP process and ensure an effective planning and decision-making process across the organization

· Drive the monthly planning cycle across Sales, Production, Procurement, and Logistics

· Analyze forecast versus actual demand and translate insights into improvement initiatives and decision support

· Optimize inventory levels and support the balance between service levels and working capital

· Develop KPIs, dashboards, and management reporting

· Prepare scenarios and business impact analyses to support decision-making

· Contribute to the development of our data foundation and digital decision-support tools, including Power BI and future AI-enabled opportunities

· Ensure effective cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder alignment

What we are looking for

You do not need to tick every box from day one, but we imagine that you:

· Have experience within Supply Chain Planning, S&OP/SIOP, Operations, or Supply Chain Analytics

· Have worked with forecasting, inventory management, planning, or similar processes

· Hold a relevant educational background within Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field

· Have strong analytical skills and are comfortable working with large datasets

· Work in a structured manner and have a strong attention to detail

· Are able to translate data into actionable insights and improvements

· Thrive in a cross-functional environment with many stakeholders

· Communicate clearly and build strong relationships

· Are professionally proficient in English, both written and spoken. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement

It is an advantage if you:

· Have experience from an international company and collaborating with sales organizations globally

· Have experience working with ERP systems, preferably M3 or similar

· Have strong Excel skills and preferably experience with Power BI

· Have an interest in digital tools and emerging technologies

· Have experience building new processes, frameworks, or organizational structures

What we offer

We offer a central role with significant influence on the development of our future planning and decision-making processes. You will have the opportunity to build and shape a new function, work closely with the Operations leadership team, and create visible results across the organization.

Your daily work will combine analysis, business development, and operational execution, and you will become part of a highly collaborative environment where ambition, knowledge sharing, and teamwork go hand in hand.

Location: Gedved, Denmark

Questions?

If you would like to learn more about the position, please contact Claus Hjerrild, Head of Operations, Paediatrics EU & RoW, at +45 41 18 47 83.

Interested?

Please submit your CV, including a brief statement of motivation.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

About Etac

Etac is a world-leading developer of innovative assistive devices and patient handling equipment. Since 1973, we have been committed to improving quality of life for the individual, family members and caregivers.

Through our specialised product brands, we offer state-of-the-art solutions for a wide range of daily needs and care settings, for people at all stages of life. Headquartered in Sweden, Etac is a global company with around 1 500 employees, sales in over 80 countries and a revenue of approximately EUR 500 million.

We are looking for a Research Technician with a passion for research and innovation to join the Food Science Laboratory team at Arla Innovation Centre, Aarhus. If you enjoy hands-on laboratory work and have a strong interest in food science and physical analysis, this could be an opportunity for you.

The role will primarily support chemical analyses within the Food Science Laboratory. Candidates with relevant experience in physical analytical methods may have the opportunity to initially support physical analyses before transitioning into a chemistry-focused role. The balance between the two areas will vary over time according to business and project needs, providing an opportunity to develop expertise across multiple analytical disciplines.

This is a full-time fixed-term position until 31 December 2031.

About our team

We have a global role in Arla Research & Innovation (R&I) and our purpose is to transform food science into business opportunities for Arla. We drive food science-based research, partner up with product developers to create the future of dairy and support our production sites worldwide with ad hoc tasks. We are a team of scientists and technicians with vast experience in food science, and we are eager to find a new colleague to share our scientific passions with.

“In our team, we apply and develop a wide range of analytical methods to evaluate both the chemical composition and physical behaviour of our products. We use chromatographic and MS-based techniques to characterize aroma, protein, peptide, metabolite, carbohydrate and mineral profiles, alongside physical analyses such as particle and droplet size analysis, microstructure visualization, rheology, viscosity and functional characterization” says R&D Manager, Food Science Laboratory, Betina Mikkelsen

How you will make an impact

As a Research Technician you will be joining a department of 22 specialists, all experts within their fields. You will join a team of 11 technicians responsible for carrying out both physical and chemical analyses. Working closely with scientists and fellow technicians, you will contribute to a wide range of tasks and projects while having the flexibility to plan and prioritize your own work.

A typical task covers the following

• Taking in a request, coordinating and planning laboratory trials and analyses.

• Executing and reporting trials and analysis.

• Data handling, ordering the needed chemicals and maintaining our equipment.

• Our main chemistry analytical methods include GC-MS, LC-TOF, LC-QTOF and IC.

• Our main physical analytical methods include NMR, viscosity, light scattering methods, texture, stability test and advanced microscopy

• Data treatment is a big part of daily work.

What will make you successful

We expect that you have a degree as Laboratory Technician (in Danish “laborant”). Experience in chemical laboratory analyses is an advantage. Experience with physical analytical methods such as NMR, viscosity measurements, light scattering methods, texture analysis, stability testing or advanced microscopy is required for candidates who wish to start in our physical laboratory before transitioning into a chemistry-focused role.

What do we offer?

This is a temporary full-time position until 31 December 2031. Position where you grow your analytical skills and learn every day. Our positive and collaborative culture will bring out the best in you. We have an international environment where knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are key words. Finally, we offer you a team that values open communication, good team spirit, passion for science, trust and respect.

Application and contact

We will review applications and invite for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. For additional information, please call R&D Manager of Food Science Laboratory Betina Mikkelsen at +45 28253323

Frontmatec is looking for a Cost & Value Engineer to play a key role in strengthening our cost and pricing capabilities across Meat Solutions Europe.

•

•

Apply today and help us build the foundation for stronger commercial performance.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**Product Marketing Manager

__

**What we believe in:

**At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges head-on. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are important drivers in our goal to enable everyone to create sustainable solutions. This is our story. Make it your story.

**Role and tasks

**As Project Planning Specialist, you will combine project planning and control with operational sales administration support within ABB’s Medium Voltage Products business. Working closely with project managers and colleagues across sales administration, engineering, finance, procurement and operations, you will create reliable schedules, maintain accurate SAP data and provide clear insights into project costs, revenue, cash flow, risks and opportunities.

The role is designed with a broad scope. Alongside project planning responsibilities, you will support the sales administration team during peak workload periods and planned absences and help administer project-related financial guarantees. Your work will contribute to reliable project delivery, accurate commercial data and continuity in day-to-day operations. The position is based at our office in Middelfart and follows a hybrid work model.

• Maintaining and improving SAP master data, including material creation, sales item maintenance, product group structures and customer segmentation.

• Developing and maintaining integrated project schedules, including baselines, forecasts, milestones, resources and critical-path activities.

• Monitoring project progress, costs, revenue and cash flow, and providing regular reports and forecasts to the project team and relevant stakeholders.

• Identifying scheduling or cost deviations and working with project managers to define practical corrective actions.

• Creating, administering and maintaining advance payment guarantees, warranty guarantees and other project-related financial securities.

• Providing operational support and backup during peak workload periods and planned absences within the sales administration team.

• Supporting project risk, change, contract and claims management by assessing potential schedule and cost impacts and contributing to mitigation plans.

• Coordinating planning activities with engineering, procurement, finance, customers, contractors and other stakeholders while contributing to improvements in local tools and processes.

**Qualifications For The Role

**

• Hands-on experience using SAP for master data maintenance, material creation, sales item maintenance or related sales administration tasks.

• Experience with project planning, project control, project coordination or a related area.

• Ability to develop and maintain project schedules and analyze milestones, dependencies and critical paths.

• Experience monitoring project costs, forecasts, cash flow or other financial project information.

• Experience with financial guarantees, commercial administration or similar project-related documentation is helpful.

• Familiarity with project risks, changes, contracts or claims is helpful.

• A relevant educational background in engineering, finance, business, project management or another applicable field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Ability to organize information, manage parallel activities and communicate clearly in English; Danish proficiency is an advantage.

**More About Us

**At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization that emphasizes employee well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability

You will be based at our office in Middelfart, alongside team members and colleagues. In addition, we offer the possibility of working from home a few days a week.

The position reports to Product Marketing Director Morten Hellesøe.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Morten Hellesøe at +4540278387.

The application deadline is 11.11.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

Project Director, Healthcare – Aarhus

Do you want to take ownership of one of the most strategic and visible programmes in Danish digital health? As Project Director, you will lead a comprehensive, product-strategic initiative for our electronic patient record (EPR) product, which has the potential to become the foundation for international growth. Sounds exciting? Then seize the chance now!

Systematic Healthcare – a coherent healthcare system

Systematics’ healthcare solutions are used by more than 200,000 users in, among others, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK and New Zealand. Our EPR solution is the core system in a hospital and has been developed in close collaboration with our customers.

Experienced Project Director with ownership, impact and business understanding

As Project Director, you will have overall responsibility for one of Systematics’ most strategic initiatives: an extensive, long-term, product-strategic programme for our EPR product. The programme is closely linked to the EPR solution used in Western Denmark today and is characterised by high complexity, both internally and externally, with many stakeholders including our customers.

The role is not only about delivering on time, price, scope and quality - as our new Project Director, you help create the framework for the program and ensure that both our customers and Systematic realise the expected benefits.

You are the programme’s single point of accountability towards both the steering committee, our customers management and the management in Systematic.

The programme is run as a virtual organisation across tracks such as development, product management, customer projects, implementation and operations. You have no direct reports and therefore create results through influence, trust, clear direction and strong governance. You report to the Vice President for the area and work closely with our customers, Product Management and the leadership of the EPR area.

Your primary tasks will include:

• Owning the programme plan, budget and business case, and ensuring a coherent solution and the expected benefits over the programme’s lifetime.

• Establishing and driving the programme’s governance and acting as the programme’s primary representative towards customer and Systematic management, including preparing and presenting decision papers.

• Actively owning and protecting the scope: challenging new requirements, driving priorities and ensuring an effective change management process.

• Owning the roadmap, schedule, milestones, budget and resource plan, and ensuring proactive risk management with timely escalation to the steering committee.

• Ensuring delivery in accordance with the agreements and leading changes and negotiations together with our Sales and Legal teams and the Vice President.

• Managing a complex stakeholder landscape, internally and externally, including customers and their regional top management, political decision-makers, clinical leadership, partners and internal units, and ensuring that the product roadmap is aligned with the programme’s commitments.

• Building and leading the virtual programme organisation across tracks and departments by setting direction, removing obstacles and being an ambassador for culture and collaboration. At the same time, you support the organisational change that the programme entails

You will be based at our office in Aarhus and can expect customer meetings around Denmark. Your success is measured by whether the programme delivers within the agreed time, price, scope and quality, and whether the benefits of the business case are realised. An important success criterion is the trust of customers and management in the programme.

Your competencies and qualifications

We envision that you have 10–15 years of experience in programme and project management, several of them with large, complex IT programmes of similar complexity: multi-year, with several parallel tracks, many stakeholders and organisational interfaces. You hold a master’s degree, for example in engineering, IT or economics, and ideally a certification in programme management, such as PMI PgMP or Axelos MSP.

In addition, we expect that you:

• Have experience from the IT industry and with public customers, large public contracts and politically governed organisations. Experience from the healthcare sector is a significant advantage.

• Have been responsible for budget, business case and contractual commitments, including negotiating changes with customers.

• Have experience reporting to executive management and steering committees, leading in matrix or virtual organisations without formal line authority, and taking part in organisational change.

• Have a strong understanding of business and finance, as well as experience in contract and risk management.

• Speak Danish as your native language and are fluent in English.

As a person, you:

Take ownership: You act as the owner of the programme, not as an administrator of plans and reports, and you have the courage to say no and make difficult prioritisations.

Lead through influence: You create commitment and results without formal authority.

Have executive presence and political awareness: You are credible at executive level and communicate complex topics clearly and in a balanced way.

Are commercial and customer-minded: You balance customer value with Systematic’s interests and understand the importance of our customers’ work for patients and clinicians.

Are structured, proactive and resilient: You create overview, make decisions on an incomplete basis, and keep your energy and calm throughout a long, high-paced programme.

Are demanding and inclusive: You create an open and honest environment where people are heard and their work is recognised.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Do you want to help Arla shape the future of milk planning? Working with advanced forecasting, AI, and optimization, you'll assist in developing innovative solutions that predict future milk supply and optimize how milk is allocated across our global production network.

“In Supporting & Cross Functions within IT & Digital, we partner with Global Trading & Planning, Arla International, and Arla Foods Ingredients. You will become part of a strong and collaborative team working closely with business stakeholders to drive value creation, co-create digital roadmaps and ensure we realize the full value of our digital investments across Arla.__”, says IT Value Partner, Mikkel Nissen.

About the job

You will work with two central solutions supporting Global Planning One Milk Balance and One Intake. One Milk Balance is Arla’s internally developed planning system for balancing raw milk supply with the needs of our dairies. It ensures that incoming milk, fat, and by-products are allocated according to site capacities and business priorities. The solution runs on Azure and integrates with SAP IBP, One Intake, and Power BI.

One Intake is Arla’s next-generation milk intake forecasting solution. Built on Databricks, it uses modern time-series models to improve visibility into future milk supply by combining data science, farmer insights, and supply chain planning. More specifically, you will

• Develop forecasting and optimisation solutions using Python, SQL, Databricks, Azure, and MLOps.

• Support the operational performance of One Milk Balance and One Intake.

• Turn analytical insights into actionable Power BI reporting.

• Work closely with global planners to improve forecasting, planning, and decision-making.

Who are you?

You are curious about how data can solve real business challenges and are motivated by continuously improving forecasting and planning solutions through data and technology. We imagine that you bring most of the following

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related field.

• At least two years of experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar technical role.

• Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Databricks and Azure-based data solutions, including data pipelines, analytics and modelling.

• A strong analytical mindset and business curiosity, with the ability to translate complex data into practical solutions.

• A proactive and collaborative approach, with a motivation to work closely with business stakeholders.

What do we offer?

You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of data science, technology and global milk planning, contributing to solutions that help Arla forecast, balance and allocate milk across its global network. jobs.description:
Are you passionate about production planning, site scheduling, and the systems they operate in? Do you thrive in a role where you train others in new ways of working, help improving planning processes, and you have a chance to shape the future of site scheduling? If so, this could be the right opportunity for you.

We are looking for a Planning Expert in the area of site scheduling to support our roll out programme of the new scheduling system and its associated processes, as part of a central project team.

“In Planning within Arla, we’re going through a massive transformation with introducing new planning systems and new planning processes across our production sites. You will join a highly collaborative team working closely across functions to deliver these changes to site schedulers across all core markets. If you want to play a key role in the E2E Planning transformation, we would be delighted to welcome you,” says Senior Project Manager, Mark Keresztes**.**

How you will make an impact

In this role, you will be responsible for training the site schedulers across the different sites as part of the overall roll out program. By becoming an expert in our system module of choice, SAP ePPDS, you will be able to train others in the use of the system as well the ways of working that accompany it. Your primary responsibility is to deliver this in a way that enables the site schedulers to adapt and thrive in their new system environment, so they can plan effectively, optimize within the system and therefore provide a great service within this crucial area of the supply chain.

Your key responsibilities include

• Train site schedulers in the use of their new system

• Train site schedulers in the new ways of working and processes that accompany the new system

• Create new training materials and training approaches

• Plan the roll out activities needed as part of a central project team to deliver the above training

• Ensure the anchoring of the changes after each roll out, through support and reinforcements activities

• Collaborate with IT colleague on current and future developments to the planning system

What will make you successful

You are an energetic, structured, and collaborative professional who enjoys working with people on large scale projects. You excel in delivering your knowledge to others in an engaging and easy-to-understand manner.

We imagine you

• Have extensive planning experience as a production planner or site scheduler

• Have extensive experience in SAP PPDS in APO

• Have a strong understanding of master data in relation to PPDS

• Have the desire and ability to train others

• Able to communicate clearly and confidently in English

• Able to produce high quality written training material in English

• Have a continuous improvement mindset and able to challenge existing ways of working

• Are curious, proactive, and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.
